people.name: Philistia

translations.web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
translations.bsb: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and Ammonites,
translations.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
translations.asv: And the anger of Jehovah was kindled against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the children of Ammon.
